title: Write phase a scaffold verification document
description:
Create docs/verification/phase_a_scaffold.md documenting how to verify the Phase A scaffold.

The document must include:
- A short overview of Phase A deliverables (processor shell, editor shell, CMake config, build script, gitignore).
- The frozen product identity table: plugin name ShredBoost, vendor nSpace Systems, version 1.0.0, PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE NSPC, PLUGIN_CODE ShBs, BUNDLE_ID com.nspacesystems.shredboost, LV2URI urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredboost, FORMATS VST3 LV2 Standalone.
- The bus-layout acceptance contract: mono-in/mono-out, mono-in/stereo-out, stereo-in/stereo-out supported; others rejected.
- Exact paste-and-run verification commands: 'cmake --preset linux-release' and 'cmake --build build --config Release' (or 'bash scripts/build_all.sh'), and where to find the built VST3/LV2/Standalone artifacts.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt and CMakePresets.json from a.3 for the identity values and preset name.
- scripts/build_all.sh from a.4 for the build command.
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp from a.1 for the bus-layout contract.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the file listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: The document lists the frozen identity values (ShredBoost, nSpace Systems, NSPC, ShBs, com.nspacesystems.shredboost, urn:nspacesystems:plugin:shredboost)
The document lists the three supported bus layouts and states others are rejected
The document includes the paste-and-run cmake configure and build commands
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify source, CMake, or script files
invent identity values that differ from the frozen product identity
